title: Elizabeth Cady Stanton's birth chart
metaDescription: Elizabeth Cady Stanton's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.5° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Fixed signs carry three of the nine placements whose signs are settled — the broadest certain weighting in the chart. The fixed signs hold what the cardinal signs start; a chart weighted there finishes its sentences.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 19.5° Scorpio — deep enough in the second decan (10°–20°) that Jupiter, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Scorpio (18.1°), Venus in Libra (12.9°), Mars in Aries (17.5°): thought steeped in tone and memory, attraction that begins as conversation, effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Saturn to Uranus, a sextile with 0.5° of slack. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, Mars trine Neptune at 1.0°, and the Sun conjunction Mercury at 1.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, three placements stand out. Venus in Libra at 12.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Aries at 17.5° is in domicile; Saturn in Aquarius at 6.6° is in domicile. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 3 water, 3 air, 3 fire; by modality, 3 fixed, 3 cardinal, 3 mutable. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Mercury, Mars and Pluto were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Pisces into Aries during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.2° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
